findings_and_relationships.classification: Existing 059 q1046 and prior 95e contextual-presence assessment; no additional unique count.
findings_and_relationships.observation: Context membership requires a well-formed half-open time interval; equal entered/left is well formed but contains no minute. Observer case-site visibility checks uniquely active occupancy, canonical matching site, observer-specific exact-site knowledge, and patient visibility where applicable. A contact reducer requires current actor time, an exact case/hostile reference and matching membership revision, collects candidate rows, then requires exactly one and an allowed decision; exact retry returns earlier when its tuple matches. These are bounded source safeguards, not proof of all materialization paths or transaction outcomes.
findings_and_relationships.producer: The inspected roster materializer checks existing context kind/location/role and count, detects a deterministic character ID collision, creates a persistent field character, and inserts an open membership with revision 1. Its field-character constructor calls insert_character_with_origin, which records a birth row when absent. This does not establish all births, deletions, retries, direct DB writers or supported missing-record policy.

findings_and_relationships.classification: Previously recorded ASSESSMENT-L01-PRESENCE-SAFEGUARD-95E conditional question; no new unique finding or assumed alias.
findings_and_relationships.observation: The contextual view helper in this assigned file requires a birth row for character_alive_at_for_view, like the inspected reducer chronology helper. The separate outbreak patient availability view uses is_none_or on the birth lookup, while its reducer counterpart delegates to character_alive_at, which uses is_some_and. If a character lacks birth metadata and all other context-specific checks pass, these helpers can classify that state differently; they are distinct paths, and this source review does not establish that both projections describe the same concrete interaction or that the state is reachable.
findings_and_relationships.safeguards: The inspected field-character creation path calls insert_character_with_origin and record_character_birth; the latter inserts a birth row if absent. Other creation/deletion paths and native transactions remain open.
findings_and_relationships.future_direction: Decide supported missing-birth state and life-record policy across each actual view/reducer pair, preserving historical chronology and observer privacy; verify producers before assigning effect.

findings_and_relationships.classification: Prior 774 Native069 source-loss qualification with bounded current contextual-treatment support; not assigned a new count or automatic q181 alias.
findings_and_relationships.observation: The current contextual-treatment helper returns Unavailable for missing/dead actor or patient and first checks actual co-presence. For two actors in the same nonempty settlement, the inspected co-presence helper returns true without requiring a clock. The later treatment helper uses StrategicMinute::ZERO when the actor clock is absent when filtering contextual rows, then may use a same-party preference if no contextual row/claim applies. The exact relationship to q181 is a policy/alias question.
findings_and_relationships.surgery_guard: For the inspected surgery flow, require_together precedes an initial decision, but align_and_advance later requires both actor and patient clock rows before the second decision. Thus this trace does not demonstrate an accepted or committed treatment without a clock; full caller set, prior guards, effects/rollback and supported missing-row reachability remain open.
findings_and_relationships.future_direction: At the correct authority boundary, determine whether missing clock is supported and whether it must remain explicit; preserve ordinary same-settlement, same-party and emergency/refusal rules and account for later validation.

nonfindings.observation: Reversed context intervals are rejected by context_membership_valid_at; an equal entered and left value is well formed but has no active instant under the right-open predicate. Unique occupancy and exact claim selection reject ambiguity.
